title: Nomura Doubles Minimum Work-From-Office Requirement in Japan
summary: Nomura Holdings Inc. plans to start requiring employees in Japan to spend the equivalent of two days a week in the office — double the current rate — as the country’s largest brokerage moves closer to the post-pandemic norm for many global banks.
